neighbours.label: ' of' after 'a different part' / 'part' in a literal part-of-a-whole phrase ('a different part of the tissue'); the + pole takes the preposition inside fixed idioms ('icing on the cake', 'tip of the iceberg')
fire: Each camera films a different part of the factory floor.
Every spring the gardeners replant a different part of the park.
Each beam of light strikes a different part of the retina.
The guide showed us a different part of the old castle each day.
Each survey team mapped a different part of the coastline.
The three nurses each cover a different part of the ward.
Each microphone picks up a different part of the orchestra.
The cleaners scrub a different part of the ship's hull every week.
quiet: Each camera films the factory floor from a different angle.
Every spring the gardeners replant the park in a different style.
Each beam of light strikes the retina at a different time.
The guide showed us the old castle by a different route each day.
Each survey team mapped the coastline with a different instrument.
The three nurses each cover the ward on a different shift.
Each microphone picks up the orchestra at a different volume.
The cleaners scrub the ship's hull with a different brush every week.

notes: Card: ' of' x14, ' in', ' on' linking a part / member / point to a literal whole. Probes: 'a different part of the' 0.47 and 0.24; 'members of' 0.33 and 0.16; other part-whole nouns (range, period, section) under 0.1; no preposition 0.04-0.08. Narrow label; the median may fall short.
